name: Rapture Pox
body:
Type disease, injury; Save Fortitude DC 14

Incubation 1d3 days; Frequency 1/day

Effect 1d4 Wis and 1d4 Cha damage; as long as a character suffers ability damage, he is sickened.

A carrion golem transmits rapture pox on a successful slam attack.
